{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column: look for values that are not valid floats
# We'll try to convert to float and see what fails

# First, check for any non-numeric strings
non_numeric = df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.]', na=False)

# Show any non-numeric entries
print("Non-numeric revenue entries:")
print(df['revenue'][non_numeric].unique())

# Now try to convert to float, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for NaN values
print("\nNumber of NaN values in revenue_clean:", df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum())

# Show the first few cleaned values
print("\nFirst 10 cleaned revenue values:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head(10))"}
